The [[Brixian]] [[warlord]] known as the '''Butcher of Brix''' spent [[time]] on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] while the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was on the world in [[9 BBY]]. In [[34 ABY]], he was a patron of [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] when [[Resistance]] agents [[Mission to Canto Bight|entered]] the establishment.

==Biography==
The Butcher of Brix was an [[insectoid]]<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" /> [[Brixian]]<ref name="Minecraft News" /> [[warlord]] associated with [[Brix]] that found himself<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" /> far from [[Homeworld|home]]<ref name="Topps" /> on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> in [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> The Butcher stood with two [[human]]s in one of Daiyu's streets when the [[spice dealer]] [[Tetha Grig]] offered [[spice]] to the [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] nearby.<ref name="Kenobi II" />

In [[34 ABY]], the Butcher of Brix was a patron of<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The warlord was stood at one of the [[casino]]'s [[gambling]] tables beside a [[Namara]] in a white [[Clothing|dress]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]], [[Rose Tico]], and [[BB-8]] entered the establishment while [[Mission to Canto Bight|searching]] for the [[Master Codebreaker]]. The Butcher was then stood by a different table with fellow patron<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Snook Uccorfay]]<ref name="TLJ VD" /> when the drunken patron [[Dobbu Scay]] accosted BB-8.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
The Butcher of Brix had [[Color|black]], [[chitin]]ous skin with a white-fronted torso that had a red strip down the middle. He had four red [[eye]]s and [[spider]]-like [[Mouth|mandibles]]. Both it/its<ref name="Topps" /> and he/him pronouns were used for the Butcher.<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" />

==Equipment==
While on Daiyu, the warlord wore a black [[cape]].<ref name="Kenobi II" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The warlord had two very beautiful ladies by his side, all the time. He's fully animatronic; there's no performer in him. Super-slime dripping from his mouth, caught in a glass very delicately by a lady.|[[Neal Scanlan]]|<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" />}}
[[File:ButcherOfBrix.png|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of the Butcher of Brix]]
The Butcher of Brix was a fully animatronic character created for the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. Concept art of the character titled "King 11" was created by creature concept designer [[Ivan Manzella]]. In early drafts for the film, the character known as the [[Master Codebreaker]] revealed to the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] that he had been casing the Butcher of Brix for over a [[Standard year|year]] and was planning to steal the blood jewels that financed the insectoid warlord's murderous regime.<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" />

Although the character's name did not appear in the final release of the film,<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> its use in the early drafts was revealed in the reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'', which was written by [[Phil Szostak]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" /> It was then used to refer to the character in the non-[[canon]] ''Star Wars'' Sequel Skin Pack for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Minecraft]]'',<ref name="Minecraft">''[[Minecraft]]''</ref> which was released on [[March 27]], [[2018]].<ref name="MinecraftDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/minecraft-star-wars-sequel-skin-pack/BTW74X3D2R8G|text=Buy ''Star Wars'' Sequel Skin Pack|work=Xbox|archiveurl=https://archive.md/rMJC1}}</ref> A card in the [[2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|2023 Topps Disney ''Star Wars Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] set released by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]] in [[2023]] then canonically used the name, identifying a character<ref name="Topps" /> that had appeared in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series,<ref name="Kenobi II" /> on [[May 27]], [[2022]],<ref name="Episode 1 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|date=2022-05-27|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> as also being the Butcher.<ref name="Topps" />
